title: Change priority of a process group
summary: Adjust the CPU priority for all processes belonging to a specific process group.

steps.explain: Use the -g flag to target all processes in a specific process group ID.

placeholders.name: NICENESS_VALUE
placeholders.description: The new priority level, from -20 (highest) to 19 (lowest).

placeholders.name: PROCESS_GROUP_ID
placeholders.description: The ID of the process group.

rollback.explain: To revert, set the niceness back to 0 for that group.

warnings: Requires root privileges to change priorities for groups you do not own.
